# LLMS — Technical Overview for openOODA
File: website/llms.txt

This file is the technical overview at https://openooda.org/llms.txt.
Home: https://openooda.org • Organization: https://github.com/openOODA

## 1. What openOODA Is

openOODA is an AI-native, capability-secured, fail-closed computing stack built from first principles across eight unified layers (`L0` through `L7`). It fuses three foundational paradigms into a single architecture:
1. **Systems & OS Architecture (Linux/Unix Heritage)**: Bare-metal microkernel isolation, Landlock/IOMMU hardware enforcement, zero-root system services, and composable userland tools.
2. **Cryptographic Authority & Provenance (At Silicon Speed)**: Explicit bearer capabilities, conservation of authority (monotonic attenuation without privilege escalation), Merkle-DAG AST and build provenance, post-quantum warrants, and deterministic resource/memory quotas—enforced at compile time and nanosecond kernel speed without blockchain consensus latency.
3. **Autonomous AI (Closed-Loop OODA & Adversarial Falsification)**: Bounded Observe–Orient–Decide–Act engines and formal verification loops where AI agents synthesize and verify software inside strict capability budgets.

In conventional languages and operating systems, code runs with ambient authority: any imported library or generated routine inherits the privileges of the host process. openOODA eliminates ambient authority across the entire computing stack:

- **Zero Ambient Authority**: Every process starts with no privileges. External effects (filesystem, network, IPC, devices, display) require an explicit capability.
- **Single-Cycle 64-Bit Capability Architecture (`32 + 32 = 64`)**: Making full use of every 64-bit CPU cycle—the lower 32 bits (`WHAT`) encode all 32 Root Capabilities (`13` Hardware + `19` Software/OS, fitting a single 32-lane GPU warp mask and 32-bit seccomp-BPF accumulator), while the upper 32 bits (`HOW & WHEN`) encode a 16-bit OODA Epoch (instant revocation) + 8-bit Rights Mask (`R/W/X/Delegate/Revoke`) + 8-bit Scope Badge, validated together in 1 CPU clock cycle.
- **Compile-Time & Hardware Verification**: Capability requirements and memory bounds are verified ahead of execution by the compiler and enforced at runtime by hardware and kernel isolation boundaries.
- **Deterministic Execution**: Linear arena allocation and zero-copy message passing provide predictable latency without garbage-collection pauses.

## 2. The 8-Layer Architecture (L0–L7)

- **Root Umbrella (`@openOODA`)**: Architectural standards, documentation portal, installer, and package catalog.
- **Layer 0 (`L0` — Core)**: Capability-secure systems language, self-hosting native compiler, deterministic standard library, and developer toolchain.
- **Layer 1 (`L1` — Kernel)**: Capability microkernel, hardware abstraction layers, IOMMU isolation, and user-space device drivers.
- **Layer 2 (`L2` — OS)**: Zero-root operating system services, capability filesystems, networking, and isolated compatibility realms.
- **Layer 3 (`L3` — Tools)**: Capability-scoped userland command-line utilities and structured data pipelines.
- **Layer 4 (`L4` — Desktop)**: Capability compositor, spatial window management, interactive privacy portals, and command deck UI.
- **Layer 5 (`L5` — Apps)**: Native productivity, creative, communication, and developer applications.
- **Layer 6 (`L6` — Cloud)**: Distributed compute grid, content-addressed storage, encrypted mesh networking, and cluster scheduling.
- **Layer 7 (`L7` — Agents)**: Bounded autonomous OODA loops (Observe, Orient, Decide, Act), verification engines, and fleet governance.

## 3. Live Telemetry, Usability Matrix & Agent Release Provenance

- **Live Flight & Architecture Status (`https://status.openooda.org`)**: Continuously synced 9-organization (`Root + L0–L7`) telemetry tracking live agent quota pacing (`90%` soft throttle / `95%` hard cutoff, `>=5%` reserve floor), `USABLE` vs `SCAFFOLD` repository counts (`383/383` `100.0%` usable across `392` total repos with `0` scaffolds: `openOODA` `6/6` `100%`, `openOODA-core` `10/10` `100%`, `openOODA-kernel` `16/16` `100%`, `openOODA-OS` `18/18` `100%`, `openOODA-tools` `261/261` `100%`, `openOODA-DE` `20/20` `100%`, `openOODA-apps` `17/17` `100%`, `openOODA-cloud` `18/18` `100%`, `openOODA-agents` `17/17` `100%`), RFC 0012 Unix "Less-Is-More" multi-call `sys_argv0` symlink dispatch, `102/102` KVM microVM verification, and GPU buildbox health across the fleet build nodes.
- **Multi-Agent Release Provenance**: Every repository release across all 9 organizations carries an annotated git tag and GitHub release documenting the exact implementing/reviewing agent (`vibe (GLM-5.3 [high])`, `mcode (M3.1-Flash)`, `devin (SWE-2 High)`, `devin (SWE-2 Max)`, `claude-opus-4-6`, `grok (Grok 4.7 [high])`, `agy (Gemini 4 Argon [high])`), workspace layer, commit hash, and deterministic binary SHA-256.
